fresh_repository_liveness.meaning: Legacy metrics/control-plane publication remains live after HARD_OFF; this is not itself proof of provider calls or host identity.

blocking_review_finding.finding: v2 currently treats systemd/cron evidence as bound when it contains any LEGACY_PATTERN, rather than proving that the owning object is bound to the concrete matched_patterns of the root being assessed. A unit or scheduler entry for one Clay legacy process can therefore be misapplied as authority for a different matched root.
blocking_review_finding.required_fix: Bind every actionable restart object to the exact root PID/cgroup/unit and that root's matched_patterns. Add adversarial cross-root tests where a forge-owned unit/cron entry must not authorize termination of a distillery/supervisor root. For systemd, prefer PID-to-unit/cgroup membership evidence in addition to unit ExecStart/cat content.

exact_action: Do not use the current v2 receipt to disable, kill, or mutate any process/service/scheduler.
Patch v2 so SYSTEMD and CRON evidence is root-specific rather than any-legacy-pattern-specific.
Add cross-root transplant negatives: evidence for one legacy entrypoint must not authorize a different matched root.
For SYSTEMD, bind the observed root PID/cgroup to the exact unit and separately bind that unit's configuration to the same matched entrypoint.
Only after source patch plus adversarial tests, create a new separately pinned execution request and run read-only attribution on the live Clay host.
After a later unambiguous attribution, disable exact restart authority first, terminate only the bound Clay tree descendants-first, and require >=90 seconds zero survivors, descendants, and restarts.
